text:
1. 17. 22

Atīta dukkha suttaṃ

189. cakkhuṃ bhikkhave dukkhaṃ atītaṃ, sotaṃ dukkhaṃ atītaṃ, ghānaṃ dukkhaṃ atītaṃ, jivhā dukkhā atītā, kāyo dukkho atīto, mano dukkho atīto. Evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, sotasmimpi nibbindati, ghānasmimpi nibbindati, jivhāyapi nibbindati, kāyasmimpi nibbindati, manasmimpi nibbindati. Nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti. Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
